result_text: Both tooltips now HTML-escape the repository name, so a name like `acme "shop"` shows as plain text in the hover. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or render a report, so the hover text itself is unchecked. The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`: - **Language blocks:** `addLangInfo` escapes the name in `name (N LOC)`. The test and other-code variants go through the same method. - **Size table:** the "Repositories Size Distribution" tooltip escapes the name in `name LOC`. - **Import:** I added `org.apache.commons.text.StringEscapeUtils`. It compiled in `reports`, so the dependency is already available there. Only the name is escaped. Counts, LOC, order and layout are unchanged.
